## My WhatsApp account was blocked incorrectly after a legitimate number change.
⭐️  
  
I’m extremely disappointed with WhatsApp. My phone number was banned, and I was completely locked out of my own account. I tried repeatedly to contact WhatsApp for help and to resolve the issue, but I never received any meaningful assistance or a proper explanation.  
  
Being unable to access my own account, while receiving no real support from WhatsApp, has been extremely frustrating. I expected a reliable support system, especially for an app that many people depend on for important personal and business communication.  
  
Very disappointing experience. I feel completely unsupported by WhatsApp.

September 22, 2026
